title: feat(spec, metadata-protocol): the draft list and the commit timeline tell two languages of one email template apart — each entry carries member (#23073)
body:
Fixes #23073
Clause-②: yes (widening: a new declared response key)

Completes ruling 6116165299 (letter A) on #22877 for the two list doors: each bundle member is addressable by name, and now each list entry says which member it is. Stage 2 (PR #23070, `038d4c958`) gave the by-name `/meta` doors the `member` selector; the lists still answered two languages of one `email_template` as two entries with the same `type` and `name`, so a reader could not tell them apart or address the second one.

## What changed

### Contract (`@objectstack/spec`, `domain:spec`)

- `ListDraftsResponseSchema` (`GET /meta/_drafts`): each draft entry gains `member: z.string().optional()`.
- `ListPackageCommitsResponseSchema` (`GET /packages/:id/commits`): each commit item gains `member: z.string().optional()`.
- Both describes say the same thing: the bundle member the entry is, for a type whose identity is a pair (today only `email_template`, `(name, locale)`); its discriminator value (`zh-CN`), with the canonical member spelled out (`en-US`); present on every entry of such a type; absent for a type whose identity is its name alone; it is the by-name doors' `member` selector (`?member=`) for that entry.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` and `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` (`check:generated` proved only `check:docs` stale; `--fix` regenerated that one and re-checked it green). No `authorable-surface`, `api-surface` or `json-schema` artifact moved: these are response shapes, and no export was added.

### Serving (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `domain:engine`, cross-domain exception per triage 6129686435)

- `listDrafts`: serves the repository header's stored `member` (`SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts`, the `bundle_member` column through `storedRowMemberHeader`), which it used to strip.
- `listCommits`: serves the stored revert-plan item's `member` (`CommitPlanItem`, the member `revertCommit` acts on), which it used to strip.
- Both go through `bundleMemberDiscriminator(type, storedMember)`, the stage-2 function every by-name door already uses to turn a selector into a discriminator value. It is keyed on `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`, the one declaration of which types are discriminated. There is no second list of types, and nothing is read off the body.
- Stored, the canonical member is NULL (the column) or an absent key (the plan). This is the ruling's "NULL means the canonical member". The list spells it out as `en-US` rather than omitting it. The reasons:
  - Key presence then answers "is this type discriminated" for every entry: triage's direction is "carry `member` for a discriminated type, and nothing for a name-only type".
  - Two languages read as two distinct values, not one value beside an absence.
  - `?member=en-US` is the same request as no selector (stage 2's `resolveBundleMemberSelector`), so the spelled-out value round-trips through every by-name door.
- Only these two serving regions of `protocol.ts` changed, plus one comment-only docblock (`CommitPlanItem`, near L2093) whose sentence "the commit timeline serves the declared four keys only" this PR makes false. The three open PRs editing `protocol.ts` (#23085 landed since; #23075, #22900) are hunk-disjoint from these.

## Premises measured on `origin/main` (`a22e67b3c`)

- The repository draft header carries `member` when it is non-canonical (`storedRowMemberHeader`, `sys-metadata-repository.ts`), and the protocol stripped it: `drafts.map(({ member: _member, ...header }) => header)`. **Holds.**
- The stored plan item carries `member` when it is non-canonical (`CommitPlanItem`), and `listCommits` stripped it the same way. **Holds.**
- Re-declarations of either list shape, by grep over `packages/**/src` (excluding `dist`):
  - `@objectstack/client`: `meta.listDrafts` and `packages.listCommits` return `ListDraftsResponse` / `ListPackageCommitsResponse` imported from `@objectstack/spec/api`. This is derived, not a re-declaration, so it widens with the schema. Its `return-type-precision.test.ts` pins `toEqualTypeOf` against those same imported types.
  - `@objectstack/rest`: `GET /meta/_drafts` answers `res.json(result)`, a pass-through. The route ledger names the schema by string.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: the `/metadata/_drafts` and `/packages/:id/commits` dispatcher arms pass the protocol answer through (`success({ commits })`). The route ledger names the schemas by string.
  - `@objectstack/cli`: zero reads of either list.
  - Result: **no re-declaration exists**, so none was updated.
- The one discriminated-type predicate: stage 2's `resolveBundleMemberSelector` and `bundleMemberDiscriminator` both read `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`). This PR reuses `bundleMemberDiscriminator`.

## Pins

- `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` (stage 1/2's real-engine harness, real `ObjectQL` and protocol):
  - New: `en-US` and `zh-CN` drafts of one template, bound to a package, read from `listDrafts` as two entries `[email_template, acme.welcome, en-US]` and `[…, zh-CN]`. Each listed `member` is handed back to the by-name door (`getMetaItem({ state: 'draft', member })`) and reads its own draft's wording. After `publishPackageDrafts`, `listCommits` reads the commit's two items with the same two members, and each item's `member` reads its own published wording through `getMetaItem`.
  - Inverted: stage 2's pin that a commit item carries no `member` key now asserts `zh-CN` on both the publish commit and its revert. The stage-2 comment "the public draft list keeps its declared header (no `member`)" is removed, and its assertion (`drafts` empty after a discard) is kept.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository-14938-list-drafts-updated-at.test.ts` §D: two `email_template` draft rows (`bundle_member` NULL and `zh-CN`) whose bodies BOTH say `en-US`, so the served member is shown to come from the stored column, not the body. They read as `en-US` / `zh-CN`. An `object` draft's keys are exactly the six declared ones, with no `member` key. The response parses as `ListDraftsResponseSchema` with every member preserved.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-14038-list-commits-created-at-iso.test.ts`: a stored plan of an `email_template` item without `member`, one with `member: 'zh-CN'`, and an `object` item serves `en-US`, `zh-CN`, and no key. It parses as `ListPackageCommitsResponseSchema` with every member preserved.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts` and `package-lifecycle.test.ts`: two members of one template plus a name-only entry parse, the parse keeps `member`, and the name-only entry has no `member` property.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

One-off, from the committed fix at `fe5c3a5e3`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. In each leg the anchor hit exactly once and the blob changed. Each restore was proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, and the final tree diff was 0 lines. Predicted direction for each leg: red, exactly the new case.

| leg | mutation | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A1 | `listDrafts` serves `header` (no member) | `sys-metadata-repository-14938…`: `1 failed \| 18 passed (19)`: the #23073 case |
| A2 | `listCommits` serves `item` (no member) | `protocol-14038…`: `1 failed \| 4 passed (5)`: the #23073 case |
| B1 | `ListDraftsResponseSchema` key renamed away from `member` | spec `protocol.test.ts`: `1 failed \| 184 passed (185)`: the #23073 case |
| B2 | commit-item key renamed away from `member` | spec `package-lifecycle.test.ts`: `1 failed \| 19 passed (20)`: the #23073 case |

The objectql harness leg was not ablated. It reads `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` from `dist` (`KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS`), so an ablation there needs a rebuild per leg. The serving it exercises is the code that A1 and A2 ablate at source level.

## Tests and gates (each reading names the tree it was taken on)

Targeted pins and the ablation ran at `fe5c3a5e3`. The merge that followed, to `f735cffa6`, brought only `packages/rest`, `packages/runtime` and two changesets, none of which these packages depend on.

- **Targeted:** spec `protocol.test.ts` and `package-lifecycle.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 205 passed (205)`. metadata-protocol's two edited files: `2 passed`, `24 passed`. The objectql harness: `1 passed`, `20 passed`.
- **`@objectstack/spec`:** `typecheck` (tsc, scripts and the test program) exit 0, at `fe5c3a5e3`. `check:generated` proved only `check:docs` stale. `--fix` regenerated it and re-checked it green, and the other 13 artifacts were green.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`:** `typecheck` exit 0. Its `tsc` program includes both edited test files (`--listFiles`: 2 of 2). The full `test` ran at `fe5c3a5e3`: `Test Files 228 passed | 3 skipped (231)`, `Tests 28207 passed | 19 skipped (28226)`.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`:** `typecheck` exit 0, `check:test-typecheck` ledger held, at `fe5c3a5e3`. The full `test` ran at `f735cffa6`: `Test Files 408 passed (408)`, `Tests 7975 passed (7975)`.
- **`@objectstack/client`** (consumer: its two list methods return the spec types), at `f735cffa6`:
  - `tsc --noEmit` (build program): exit 0.
  - `return-type-precision.test.ts`, `unwrap-misfire.pin.test.ts` and `meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts`: `3 passed`, `27 passed`.
  - The test program (`tsconfig.test.json`) is a narrowed reading. 0 errors fall in those three files. All 35 errors elsewhere are `TS2307` cannot-find-module for unbuilt devDependency `dist` (`@objectstack/runtime`, `objectql`, `plugin-hono-server`, …). So the whole-program verdict is NOT MEASURED here and is left to CI.
- **`@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`:** pass-throughs with no re-declaration (see the premises section). No test owed: the public byte surface they touch is the spec type, already read above.
- **`@objectstack/cli`:** zero reads of either list, so no `unit` run is owed.
- **Lint, targeted:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 9 changed `.ts` files: `files_linted=9 errors=0 warnings=0`.
  - All 9 files fall in the config's own `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` object; the json lists all 9, so none is ignored.
  - The narrowing excludes nothing untouched: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, stated in `eslint.config.mjs`), and its plugins are per-file rules. A diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- **Derived gate families,** at `f735cffa6`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 114, and each ran with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran` printed: `114 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
  - Three first runs refused their prerequisite, and each was re-run at the same head after its prerequisite was met. All three re-runs exited 0:
    - `check-engine-split-ratio`: shallow clone. Re-run after `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-07 origin main`.
    - `check:skill-examples`: needs the client and client-react `dist`. Re-run after building them.
    - `check:lean-entry-closure`: needs the objectql `dist`. Re-run after building it.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It needs every package's `dist`, with 59+ unbuilt here, and a whole-monorepo build is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, not fixed here (read, not measured at a door).** The package-batch result arrays name two members of one template identically too: `publishPackageDrafts`' `published[]` / `failed[]`, `discardPackageDrafts`' `discarded[]` / `failed[]`, and `revertCommit`'s `reverted[]` / `failed[]` carry `{ type, name }` only. That is the same shape this card closes for the two lists. Carrier: none.
- **A pending changeset sentence this PR makes false.** `.changeset/22877-member-selector.md` (stage 2, unreleased) says "The protocol's draft list (`GET /meta/_drafts`) does not include it." That file is outside this claim's file surface, so it is not edited here. This PR's changeset says the earlier sentence is superseded. The one-line amendment belongs to the seat: delete that sentence, or replace it with "The protocol's draft list serves it too."
- **Comment-only edits outside the two serving regions.** Two docblocks whose sentences this PR made false: `CommitPlanItem` in `protocol.ts` and the `member` header doc of `SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts`.
- **The objectql harness** is the serving's real-engine test, and it held stage 2's opposite pin. It is edited as the serving's test.
- Studio's half (`DraftChangesPanel` addressing each entry with `?member=`) is objectstack-ai/objectui#12271.
